content.title: CEO: Presidio Takes Western Anadarko PDP Story Public Via SPAC
content.summary: Presidio Petroleum aims to stand out among publicly traded U.S. E&Ps, co-CEO Will Ulrich told Hart Energy. Instead of drilling new wells, Presidio bolts on low-decline PDP assets, currently focused on the Western Anadarko Basin.

content.title: Presidio Petroleum to Go Public in Merger with EQV Ventures
content.summary: Presidio Petroleum plans to go public in a SPAC merger with EQV aimed at building the next big oil and gas producer in the Texas Panhandle—and is poised to capitalize on a wave of asset divestitures.

content.title: Energy Executives Plan EQV Group’s Second Blank-Check IPO
content.summary: The $350 million of funds raised will go into escrow alongside the $350 million raised from EQV Group’s first SPAC IPO as the 10-month-old prospective M&A buyer has not yet done a deal.
